description: Public Service Commission - Amendment to the Schedule B to the notice of delegation of powers to the Education Committee Published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1989/29 of 19.10.2016 w.e.f. 20.10.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the delegation of powers by the Public Service Commission regarding appointments, promotions, transfers, and disciplinary control of public officers in the education sector. The content is specifically about public service administration, falling under the definition of Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) which cover public service recruitment, service conditions, and administrative instructions from the Public Service Commission.
